product.title: Front Office — Eastfield Eagles
product.summary: The Track 201 counterpart: inherit a team already over the cap and dig out across eight turns.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students take over a franchise starting in the red against the cap and work eight turns teaching Bird Rights, the mid-level exception, luxury tax, market-size economics, market inefficiency, roster windows, pick value under uncertainty and surplus value against risk, ending in a cap-efficiency score.

studentDataProfile.notes: Requires a student account and Track 201 Module 2 completion. Descriptive only.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete and server-scored, reusing the Westbrook decision engine. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Route exists in a deployed site; gated, so end-to-end reachability was not probed anonymously.
knownBlockers: Gated behind a student account and prior module completion.

provenance.evidence: BOW-WEBSITE/lib/sim-eastfield.ts starts the team below zero cap space across eight turns and reuses the SimChoice and SimDecision shapes from lib/sim-game.ts.
